python -c "import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); path=data.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); blocked_paths=['.env', 'credentials', 'secret', '.pem', '.key']; path_match=next((b for b in blocked_paths if b in path.lower()), None); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':f'Protected path: {path_match}'}})) if path_match else sys.exit(0)"

python -c "import sys,json,datetime,os,re;data=json.load(sys.stdin);cmd=data.get('tool_input',{}).get('command','');out=str(data.get('tool_result',{}).get('stdout',''));rc=data.get('tool_result',{}).get('exitCode',0);is_test='pytest' in cmd or 'python -m pytest' in cmd;log_dir='logs';os.makedirs(log_dir,exist_ok=True);ts=datetime.datetime.now().isoformat();lines=[];lines.append(f'{ts} CMD: {cmd[:200]}') if is_test else None;lines.append(f'  EXIT: {rc}') if lines else None;fail_match=re.search(r'(\d+) failed',out) if is_test else None;pass_match=re.search(r'(\d+) passed',out) if is_test else None;lines.append(f'  TESTS: {pass_match.group(1) if pass_match else 0} passed, {fail_match.group(1) if fail_match else 0} failed') if is_test and lines else None;open(f'{log_dir}/tool_results.log','a').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n') if lines else None;sys.exit(0)"
